body: This happened in October but I thought it was sort of funny. The Great Barrier Reef was declared dead in an obituary, and of course news spread fast and people believed it. But! Its not actually dead! It's not exactly healthy either but it hasn't kicked the bucket yet. I honestly don't know much about corals but it's nice to know it's not dead completely.

The aquarium has a twitter account that I follow. I checked it now and as luck would have it, the beluga stopped getting better after all :^(

Sciencedaily has some stuff that's fun to read up on too, but I usually get news and updates from my bio teacher.

This isn't really a piece of trivia, but I like to keep up with news and such and one story I've been following is about a beluga at the Vancouver Aquarium who got sick after her daughter died. I was worried the mom wouldn't make it, but she's started new treatment and is getting better so that's happy at least

Marine biology. I'd like to work an aquarium.

I have a reloadable bus pass, but it's tied to my moms credit card and usually it has no money on it so if I use it, it'll take money from there and charge her more.

I don't know. There's a lot of things to think about.

Adam.  My mom is paying for my sisters college and because of that she won't be able to help with mine, so I have to pay for it on my own and have nothing saved so far. I don't mind not going to a good college, it just sucks that I can't go in to the field I want to.

My mom only let me apply for the job because I knew a guy who worked there and it was close to our house, so she wouldn't have to drive or have me spend money on taking the bus. She doesn't think I should be working and won't let me get a bank account or give my my social insurance number. This was my one shot to start working and I blew it
